summary: Engine-free generic router in NaruServe-api: Method/MethodSet, pattern matching, priority, conflict detection at freeze, automatic HEAD/OPTIONS, WebSocket route kind, path validator, TRACE/CONNECT and path-form policies.

ambiguities.text: Explicit HEAD registration (D-063) vs automatic HEAD: if a HEAD route matches only via a less specific pattern than a GET route (HEAD /x/:id vs GET /x/me, request HEAD /x/me), does the explicit HEAD route still win or does per-method priority pick auto-HEAD from the more specific GET?
ambiguities.proposed_default: Per-method priority: explicit HEAD routes are considered first; if any HEAD pattern matches, the most specific HEAD match wins; auto-HEAD only when no HEAD pattern matches.

ambiguities.text: Same question for explicit OPTIONS (D-065): any matching OPTIONS pattern suppresses the automatic OPTIONS result.
ambiguities.proposed_default: Any matching explicit OPTIONS route yields matched; automatic OPTIONS only when none matches.

ambiguities.text: Path parameter decoding when merge-slashes/case-insensitive policies apply: confirm decoded-once values are returned unmodified and that an encoded '%2e' remnant (from %252e) in a static segment compares literally.
ambiguities.proposed_default: Values returned as decoded once, never normalised; static comparison on decoded text, case-folded only under the case-insensitive policy.
